description: Trigger evaluation queries for postgresql skill. priority: 'core' = must-trigger for the skill to be useful; 'edge' = should trigger but failure is less critical.

evals.query: Design the database table for user sessions
evals.reason: Schema design request — core use case, covers data types, PKs, indexes for the sessions table

evals.query: Which data type should I use for storing video duration?
evals.reason: Data type selection — skill's data types section guides INTERVAL vs NUMERIC vs INTEGER choice

evals.query: Add an index to speed up user search by email
evals.reason: Index design — expression index on LOWER(email) pattern is explicitly covered

evals.query: Set up row-level security so users can only see their own records

evals.query: Review this migration — is it safe to run on production?
evals.reason: Safe DDL migration review — Safe Schema Evolution section applies
